title: Conditionals
summary: Make decisions with if, elif and else.

exercises.title: Even or Odd
Adult or Minor
exercises.prompt: Read an age. Print `Adult` if 18 or more, otherwise `Minor`.

exercises.title: Sign
hints: You need if, elif and else.

exercises.title: Grade
Largest of Three
exercises.prompt: Read three integers (one per line). Print the largest.

exercises.title: Leap Year
exercises.prompt: Read a year. Print `Leap` if divisible by 4 and (not divisible by 100 or divisible by 400), else `Not leap`.

exercises.title: In Range
exercises.prompt: Read an integer. Print `In range` if it is between 10 and 20 (inclusive), else `Out of range`.

exercises.title: Login
exercises.prompt: Read a username, then a password. Print `Welcome` if the username is `admin` and the password is `python123`, otherwise `Denied`.

exercises.title: FizzBuzz Once
exercises.prompt: Read an integer n. Print `FizzBuzz` if divisible by 3 and 5, `Fizz` if by 3, `Buzz` if by 5, otherwise n.

exercises.title: Valid Triangle
exercises.prompt: Read three side lengths (integers, one per line). Print `Valid` if the sum of any two sides is greater than the third, else `Invalid`.
hints: All three conditions must be true.
exercises.solution:
a = int(input())
b = int(input())
c = int(input())
if a + b > c and a + c > b and b + c > a:
    print("Valid")
else:
    print("Invalid")

quiz.question: What prints? x=5; if x>3: print('A') elif x>1: print('B')
quiz.explanation: Only the first true branch runs.

quiz.question: What is not (True and False)?
quiz.explanation: True and False is False; not flips it.
